description: Validate and convert GS1 identifiers: GTIN-8, GTIN-12 (UPC-A), GTIN-13 (EAN-13), GTIN-14, GLN and SSCC. Returns the check-digit verdict, the computed correct check digit, the GTIN-14 form with its indicator digit, and conversion between GTIN-8, GTIN-12, GTIN-13 and GTIN-14. No company-prefix split is returned: GS1's prefix-length table is no longer public data. Also computes a missing check digit from a partial code. Structure only, no product database. Price: $0.05 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base).

op.description: validate (default), checkdigit (compute the missing final digit) or convert. Accepted: validate, checkdigit, convert.

to.description: Target format. Required when op=convert. Accepted: gtin8, gtin12, gtin13, gtin14.

value.description: GS1 code, digits with optional spaces or hyphens. For op=checkdigit, omit the final digit. Accepted: 8, 12, 13, 14 or 18 digits.

name: id_gs1
title: GS1 identifier validation: GTIN-8/12/13/14, GLN, SSCC
